name: Alex
message: I found an old wooden radio case at a flea market.

name: Rowan
message: Empty case or a radio that wants to be a repair project?

name: Alex
message: Empty case. I want to make it a little bookshelf speaker.

name: Rowan
message: That saves you inheriting someone else's wiring decisions. What finish does it have?

name: Alex
message: Dark walnut. I thought I'd paint it white.

name: Rowan
message: I like walnut but it's your case. You can try a removable paper mockup before painting.

name: Alex
message: I've changed my mind. I'll keep the wood and clean it gently.

name: Rowan
message: Wood finish stays. The white paint proposal has retired.

name: Alex
message: Also it's for the kitchen shelf rather than my desk.

name: Rowan
message: Kitchen shelf. Worth measuring that space before choosing the speaker parts.

name: Alex
message: Not today though. I'd rather just listen to some music.

name: Rowan
message: Fair. The empty box can wait without supervision.
